context: Employees and contractors can connect to the corporate VPN using only a username and password.
Three public-facing servers are more than 45 days behind on critical security patches.
Several IT administrator accounts have permanent administrative privileges and are also used for normal day-to-day activities.

risk: EDR missing on some corporate endpoints
context: Around 30 percent of employee laptops are not currently enrolled in the company's endpoint detection and response platform.
Production backups exist, but all copies remain online and are managed within the same cloud environment as production systems.

risk: Public cloud storage containing customer data
context: A cloud storage container containing customer support exports can currently be accessed publicly.

risk: Secrets stored in source code and CI/CD systems
context: Long-lived service account credentials were discovered in repository history and CI/CD environment variables.
Employee workstations and several internal application servers can communicate broadly across the internal corporate network.

risk: Security logs are not centrally monitored
context: Authentication, cloud, and administrator activity logs exist but are not consistently sent to a central SIEM for monitoring and alerting.

risk: Third-party access is not regularly reviewed
context: Several vendors still have remote access or SaaS access even after their original projects have ended.
